progression.narrative: The performance opens on G3 and dwells most on G in Daramad-e Dovom. The line peaks at Bb4 (457.9 Hz) at 0:23.2. It closes on the tonic (Bb4 → C4 → Bb4 → Ak3 → G3 → G3).
